description: This file defines a minimal API endpoint for listing catalog types in an e-commerce web application. It utilizes ASP.NET Core minimal APIs, AutoMapper for object mapping, and repository pattern for data access.

classes.name: CatalogTypeListEndpoint
classes.description: A minimal API endpoint class for retrieving a list of catalog types.

methods.name: AddRoute
methods.description: Registers the GET route for listing catalog types at 'api/catalog-types'.

methods.name: HandleAsync
methods.description: Handles the process of fetching catalog types from the repository, mapping them, and returning the response.
